approach: Static recompilation (PS2Recomp fork) with a native OpenGL renderer and audio mixer: no GS, VU1 or SPU2 emulation
notes: Playable through the start of chapter 1 (opening, Logun, battle tutorial, first battles, menus, saving). The game's EE code and IOP modules are recompiled; models, interface, post effects, movies and sound are rebuilt natively from the game's own data. Screens are matched against PCSX2 one by one. Bring your own disc (USA, SLUS-21452).
